final: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT oe.orderexecmark) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink WHERE oe.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope
